description: The logo screens shown at boot, in order. Each logo fades in, holds until a button is held or the frame counter passes hold_frames, fades out and goes to next_state; a screen with card_check checks the save cards once faded in and the result picks the next state. Fade steps are fractions of the whole fade per frame. Skip (a confirm key or the pad's skip button) starts the fade-out from the fade-in or the hold; with a card check it is latched, speeds the fade-in up and cuts the hold. Segments are [image_x, image_y, width, height, x, y]: a rectangle of the logo image and its place on the centred screen. backdrop: a flat rectangle behind the logo in the logo image's own white (backdrop_rgb). Every key is checked: an unknown key is an error.
